Interestingly, no homologues were detected in Zymomonas mobilis for three of these signature proteins (CC3319, CC1887, CC1725). Z. mobilis is also lacking a number of other signature proteins described in this study and this may be attributed to the genetic loss of a variety genes resulting in its small genome size (2.06 Mb) [33]. A number of genes for the tricarboxcylic acid cycle as well as other functions have previously been documented as missing in this genome [33]. One of these signature pro-

A homologue of the protein CC3319 was detected in the currently unclassified Magne- tococcus sp. MC-1 genome suggesting that this species may be distantly related to the α-proteobacteria [42].
